title: Work great!!!
text: Work great!!!. Omg..why didnt I get these sooner! They each come in a little box with Chinese on it. It doesnt have any instructions with it and I was wondering if you needed to hold it on the bag to heat it up first..but after just doing it, you dont need to. You just put it on the plastic where you want to seal it and slide it. It seals immediately as you begin to slide. It makes a good seal line. We have used it on chip bags and pasta bags so far and we love it! I keep one on my kitchen island at all times. I got a pink one and a white one. No more having to look for clothes pins to keep bags closed.

product_metadata.title: Mini Bag Sealer Portable Handheld Vacuum Sealer 2 in 1 Heat Sealer and Cutter for Fresh Bag, Food Storage Snack and Plastic Bags(2PACK)
